findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: page_markdown, page_meta, email_auth, seo_page, seo_audit_lite · Private data: email_auth, site_verdict · Public sink: email_auth, site_snapshot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: page_markdown, page_meta, email_auth, seo_page, seo_audit_lite · Private data: email_auth, site_verdict · Public sink: email_auth, site_snapshot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
